title: cyperus flavescens var. rehmannianus
intro: Cyperus flavescens var. rehmannianus, commonly known as Yellow Papyrus, is a species of sedge in the family Cyperaceae. It is a plant with various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Yellow Papyrus include its use as a diuretic to treat urinary tract infections and its ability to reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
